porous_transport.note: Darcy and mixture-diffusion relations from existing gas_transport.py and pore source records. Common molar-frame D, viscosity power laws and evolving brick properties are assumed. No Knudsen or Soret prediction; reciprocal-logarithmic carried-enthalpy mean preserves the stated ideal-gas entropy inequality.

quartz_nist.note: Existing local source. Source alpha/beta Cp, 847 K transition, 728 J/mol rounded JANAF latent increment. Metastable quartz extrapolation across actual high-T polymorph region remains an approximation.

solid_effective.note: Thermodynamic free-energy construction reused in an axial effective skeleton. Modulus, background expansion and quartz transition eigenstrain are explicit engineering assumptions, not measured brick properties. The transition eigenstrain follows the existing caloric phase fraction and initial quartz reference-volume fraction; not a pure-phase molar-volume or stress-dependent equilibrium law. USGS volumes at different temperatures cannot identify the isothermal phase jump.

effective_conductivity.note: Engineering closure for effective dry-solid connectivity and liquid pore filling, not a measured homogenization law. Fourier transport uses positive state-dependent k and series half-cell resistances; no extra stored or reaction energy. Exponent and liquid-volume gain are uncalibrated assumptions. Initial dry reference fraction is derived from root recipe and constituent molar volumes.

lumped_carbonization.note: Explicit engineering CH2O -> C + H2O pathway using existing proxy species, atom-balanced stoichiometry and the same formation enthalpy/entropy reference. Not a fitted sludge pyrolysis spectrum. Arrhenius coefficients and common reactivity of initial/generated char are assumed; no new independent reaction heat.

effective_liquid_phase.note: Engineering fluxed-matrix proxy carried by a fraction of current metakaolin, with unchanged Al2Si2O7 composition and molar volume. Two-state free energy gives equilibrium liquid fraction, latent enthalpy and entropy; these parameters are not pure metakaolin melting properties, measured mineral fractions or a phase diagram. No kinetic hysteresis or quenched glass.

pore_radiation.note: Declared local equilibrium pore-wall radiation closure: k_rad=4*sigma*exchange_factor*current_pore_diameter*gas_porosity*T^3. The factor represents unmeasured wall exchange and geometry, not a spectral emissivity measurement. Pore diameter inherits the assumed sintering-radius geometry; no independent optical length or spectral transport.

liquid_water_transport.note: Declared Onsager liquid-water closure with availability-weighted positive mobility and shared transported enthalpy. Mechanical potential is supplemented by the separately declared water_retention free energy in the current model. No wetting hysteresis or measured hydraulic conductivity. The diffusivity-dimensional coefficient is a mobility scale, not a measured Fick diffusivity.

water_retention.note: Ideal-mixing free energy RT*[n*ln(n/(n+N))+N*ln(N/(n+N))]. Current immobile equivalents N follow water_site_evolution; neither an extra mass inventory nor measured capacity. U_mix=0; entropy composition derivatives with respect to water and carrier are both retained. Energetic binding is separately declared.

water_phase_exchange.note: Declared seeded phase kinetics: both signed directions oppose the same water/vapor chemical-potential difference and share the evaporation Arrhenius rate. Bounded driving functions give finite log-inventory rates. Reverse prefactor proportional to existing liquid; no exactly dry nucleation, measured condensation law or resolved interface area. At unit factor paired one-way flux ratio exp(-affinity).

liquid_relaxation.note: Declared nonequilibrium extension of the existing two-state free energy: log-odds q relaxes toward its equilibrium value, with positive Arrhenius rate. Carrier birth inherits local disordered fraction; phase energy and entropy derivatives are explicit. No measured glass-transition or crystallization kinetics. Current matrix eigenstrain adds the phase_eigenstrain elastic affinity to the kinetic target; the caloric q_eq remains the stress-free reference.

water_binding.note: Declared saturating water-binding Helmholtz energy g(n)*a(T), g=N*n/(n+N); a=-E+C*(T-Tr-T*ln(T/Tr)). Positive excess capacity and convex composition free energy. Coefficients are engineering assumptions, not measured sorption heats.

gas_program.note: Predeclared virtual kiln reservoir composition at thermal-stage endpoints, linearly interpolated with process time. No plant atmosphere measurements, kiln circulation/combustion solution or recipe optimization.

water_site_evolution.note: Declared immobile site equivalents N=N0*(r+(1-r)*n_kaolin/n_kaolin_initial). A persistent fraction r remains after dehydroxylation; r is unmeasured and positive over the declared domain, not an inventory floor. Composition derivatives of the existing mixing and binding free energies enter kaolin reaction affinity and caloric/entropy ledgers. No site regeneration, independent kinetics, measured site count or sintering loss.

reversible_carbonate.note: Phenomenological reverse carbonate reaction uses the existing decarbonation Arrhenius rate, local CaO inventory, dimensionless CO2 pressure and the same pure-phase affinity. No measured reverse kinetics or product-layer model; a conserved calcite/lime inventory permits regeneration at either pure-phase endpoint.

structure_viscosity.note: Declared activated effective axial rheology: ordered active-matrix dry-volume fraction raises the barrier by E_order*phi_ordered. Existing disordered-volume gain is retained as a prefactor. No measured melt viscosity, glass transition, separate crystal kinetics, new storage or additional heat source.

porosity_stiffness.note: Declared power of dry-solid volume fraction, derived within the existing axial Helmholtz skeleton; no measured porous modulus law.

phase_eigenstrain.note: Effective axial eigenstrain B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0 of the finite-rate matrix proxy. Same Helmholtz energy supplies phase driving force and composition derivatives. No measured phase volume jump, mineral equilibrium or damage. Nonzero amplitude with active carrier requires positive relaxation time; algebraic stress-coupled phase equilibrium is outside this closure.

phase_stiffness.note: Reference-volume weighted log-modulus contrast of the existing ordered/disordered matrix proxy: K=K_porosity*exp(-g*C), C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0. Same Helmholtz energy supplies phase, carrier and mechanical derivatives. No measured phase modulus, glass transition, damage or phase-resolved mixture law.

phase_heat_capacity.note: Constant two-state Cp contrast: dh=L+c*(T-Tm), ds=L/Tm+c*ln(T/Tm), q_eq=(ds-dh/T)/b. State storage, carrier chemical potential and internal relaxation share this free energy. Nominal c=10 J/mol/K is an illustrative assumed increment, not a literature or measured value.

phase_conductivity.note: Effective dry-skeleton log conductivity contrast: multiply the dry term by exp(-gk*phi_disordered), with phi_disordered=N*x*v_matrix/V_dry. Water enhancement and pore radiation stay separate. Nominal gk=2 and signed range [-4,4] are illustrative assumptions, not measured constituent conductivities or a material-specific direction.

porosity_diffusion.note: Effective face transport tortuosity tau=1+(tau_initial-1)*(phi_initial/phi)^a with the preceding arithmetic gas porosity. a=1 and range [0,2] are illustrative assumptions, not a measured geometric or connected-pore law. Positive common-D, shared flux and conjugate carried enthalpy preserve the same entropy construction. No extra storage or Knudsen/percolation model.

pair_diffusion.note: Positive symmetric pair-mobility approximation derived for zero total molecular molar flux and nonnegative pair entropy. Six relative factors are declared illustrative hypotheses, not measured or literature binary diffusion. No Maxwell-Stefan friction inversion or Knudsen/Soret physics.

mixture_viscosity.note: Wilke low-pressure mixing equation verified in official IDAES documentation. Four pure-species reference multipliers, shared temperature power, symmetric face composition and mixing interpolation are explicit assumptions, not measured viscosity curves. Original Wilke AIP page inaccessible during this narrow check; no original-paper full-text verification claimed.

gas_caloric.note: Explicit linear ideal-gas Cp approximation anchored at existing reference Cp. h and s analytically integrated; face enthalpy derived from exact standard-state mu/T divided difference. Slopes are engineering assumptions, not literature fits or measurements.

dry_caloric.note: Explicit linear background Cp approximation anchored at existing reference values. h and s are analytic integrals, slopes are engineering assumptions, not literature fits or measurements.

water_caloric.location: docs/FULL_CYCLE_REPORT.md; src/sludge_vme/models/full_cycle_gas.py thermo, water_carried_enthalpy and caloric_capacity
water_caloric.note: Linear liquid-water background Cp anchored at existing reference values. Analytic h/s integrals and conjugate face enthalpy; engineering assumption, not measured water or sorbed-water calorimetry.

liquid_water_mobility_temperature.note: Declared reference-anchored Arrhenius mobility, D(T)=D_ref*exp[-E/R*(1/T-1/Tr)], combined with concentration in half-cell series resistances. Activation and range are engineering assumptions, not a measured hydraulic or diffusion curve. Changes kinetics only; same water potential, conjugate enthalpy and entropy production.

dry_conductivity_temperature.location: Declared effective dry-skeleton kinetic closure in this project; no material conductivity measurement.
dry_conductivity_temperature.note: Positive reference-anchored power law (T/Tr)^a changes only nonradiative dry-skeleton conduction. Water-volume enhancement and pore radiation retain their separate laws; no added storage. Nominal and range are assumptions, not fitted or literature-derived mineral properties.

thermal.conductivity.note: Nonradiative dry background conductivity at the initial dry-recipe solid fraction and initial bulk volume. Solid/liquid-water fractions modify this background; pore radiation is added separately. This nominal value is assumed, not a measured total high-temperature conductivity or pure-mineral property. Reference value is at reference.temperature; the dry temperature factor acts only on the dry contribution.

gas.sweep.note: Uniform local carrier supply per initial dry mass; no gas storage or pore-pressure dynamics.

gas.max_generated_per_carrier.note: Prescribed finite evacuation capacity, caps total generated molar rate.

gas.max_oxygen_use_fraction.note: Finite oxygen supply; common scaling preserves competing reaction ratios.

sintering.rate_ref.note: Uncoupled Arrhenius reference mobility. The disordered prefactor and ordered-structure barrier both alter actual effective axial viscosity, including at the reference temperature.

product.gradient_scale.note: Dimensionless defect indicator 1-exp(-peak_deltaT/scale); not measured defect probability.

numerics.rtol.note: Engineering solver-coordinate resolution; physical conservation and convergence acceptance thresholds unchanged. Replaces over-resolved settings that stalled a high-permeability UQ drying case.

numerics.atol.note: Engineering solver-coordinate resolution; physical conservation and convergence acceptance thresholds unchanged. Replaces over-resolved settings that stalled a high-permeability UQ drying case.

acceptance.floor.residual_carbon_kg.note: Declared denominator floor for near-zero residual carbon. Paired UQ residual-carbon differences at or below this same absolute floor are reported as ties; raw signed inventories are retained.

calibration.tolerance.note: Optimizer stopping tolerance matched to approximate forward solver; first 1e-6 attempt reached evaluation cap despite <0.2% parameter error; no extra precision target.

product.water_density.note: Ambient water density approximation used only for absorption proxy.

process.cooling_hold.end.note: Ambient final hold to complete cooling.

uq.confidence_level.note: Wilson lower bound for pairwise win probabilities, paired iid Monte Carlo draws.

acceptance.drying_remaining_fraction.note: Engineering endpoint reporting criterion for the example.

acceptance.cooling_temperature_differenc.note: Engineering endpoint reporting criterion for the example.

calibration.difference_step.note: Finite-difference perturbation / synthetic recovery acceptance; numerical setting, not material evidence.

calibration.recovery_relative.note: Finite-difference perturbation / synthetic recovery acceptance; numerical setting, not material evidence.

gas.storage.note: 1: explicit finite pore gas; 0: historical per-cell swept approximation. No implicit mode.

transport.diffusivity_ref.note: Common free-gas reference mobility scale. Positive root pair factors distinguish O2/N2/H2O/CO2 pair exchanges; not measured binary diffusivity or empirical interval.

transport.diffusivity_exponent.note: Assumed temperature power; pressure scaling Pr/P. Effective coefficient includes current porosity/tortuosity.

transport.viscosity_ref.note: Assumed common viscosity scale at reference temperature; new species multipliers and Wilke mixing determine the nominal mixture. Zero mixing restores preceding common gas viscosity.

transport.viscosity_exponent.note: Assumed power law, not a fitted viscosity curve.

transport.tortuosity.note: Assumed initial effective transport tortuosity. Current face value follows the separately declared porosity exponent; not a measured geometric path-length ratio.

transport.permeability_ref.note: Borrowed virtual pore coefficient from existing Dusty Gas setups; evolving phi^3/(1-phi)^2 scaling is assumed. Not a measured brick permeability range.

kinetics.oxygen_order.note: Oxidation rate proportional to local oxygen partial pressure divided by a fixed, explicitly declared kinetics.oxygen_reference_pressure; changing inlet oxygen does not change the kinetic reference.

acceptance.entropy_relative.note: Maximum sampled entropy closure residual divided by initial thermal capacity scale E_scale/T_ref.

acceptance.floor.peak_overpressure_pa.note: Predeclared absolute denominator scale when the reference overpressure is near zero.

numerics.jacobian_step.note: Imaginary perturbation for complex-step differentiation on each active branch. Avoids subtractive Jacobian error in the stiff gas system; physical acceptance tolerances are unchanged.

numerics.jacobian_state_scale.note: Dimensionless scale for near-zero physical coordinates in Jacobian differencing.

acceptance.inventory_roundoff_factor.note: Condensed inventory roundoff allowance = factor * float epsilon * initial total condensed molar scale. Accepted inventory values remain unchanged and raw negative minima are reported. This is an arithmetic-domain budget, not a physical negative-inventory allowance.

solid.thermoelastic.note: 0 retains prior finite-gas closure; 1 selects coupled quartz/axial skeleton.

solid.axial_modulus.note: Effective fixed-area axial modulus, not independently measured Young modulus; constant through firing. Reference effective modulus at the initial dry-solid fraction for the porosity-dependent Helmholtz law; not dense-solid modulus.

solid.thermal_expansion.note: Effective background reversible axial strain coefficient. The quartz transition contribution is separate in quartz.axial_transition_strain.

quartz.latent_heat.note: JANAF h increments 34.924 - 34.196 kJ/mol; use L/Tc entropy join.

quartz.transition_width.note: Smooth two-state free energy width: mixing entropy coefficient a=L*w/Tc^2. No measured hysteresis or phase-volume relation.

quartz.shomate_scale.note: t=T/(1000 K); Shomate entropy primitive omits constants because anchored to reference.

quartz.alpha.A.note: Cp coefficient with dimensionless t. Alpha 298-847K, beta847-1996K.

numerics.mechanical_iterations.note: Fixed Newton iterations for positive pore-volume mechanical equilibrium; actual final force residual reported.

quartz.axial_transition_strain.note: Assumed effective axial eigenstrain amplitude per unit initial quartz reference-volume fraction. Actual strain=e_q*(n_q_initial*v_q/V0)*(x_beta(T)-x_beta(T_initial)). Zero recovers the previous background-only skeleton. This engineering range is not a measured quartz volume jump, a confidence interval or a calibrated brick property.

thermal.solid_fraction_exponent.note: Power of current dry-solid volume fraction divided by initial dry reference fraction. Porosity includes liquid plus gas for this closure. Zero removes the solid-fraction correction.

thermal.liquid_volume_gain.note: Dimensionless liquid-water volume correction to the nonradiative background. At fixed total pore fraction, replacing gas with liquid increases the background conductivity. Setting this coefficient and the solid-fraction exponent to zero restores constant background k, while pore radiation requires its own zero factor. Intrinsic dry-temperature and phase factors have separate zero limits; neither multiplies the liquid enhancement.

kinetics.organic_carbonization.A.note: Effective proxy Arrhenius prefactor; zero disables only this pathway for an explicit mechanism comparison.

kinetics.organic_carbonization.E.note: Effective activation energy for the single assumed CH2O carbonization pathway, not a measured pyrolysis distribution.

kinetics.oxygen_reference_pressure.note: Fixed kinetic normalization pressure. Unlike inlet pressure normalization, it does not change when oxygen-poor reservoir conditions are selected.

liquid.active_matrix_fraction.note: Fraction of current metakaolin carrying the declared two-state matrix proxy; carrier birth inherits local phase fraction. Zero removes latent storage, kinetic phase state and mobility coupling.

liquid.transition_temperature.note: Effective equal-free-energy temperature of the two-state matrix proxy, not a pure mineral melting temperature.

liquid.latent_heat.note: Enthalpy contrast per active proxy matrix mole at liquid.transition_temperature. Shared caloric storage and chemical potentials; its temperature dependence follows liquid.heat_capacity_contrast. No separate heat source.

liquid.transition_width.note: Sets ideal two-state mixing coefficient b=L*width/Tm^2; fraction slope at Tm is 1/(4*width). Not a fitted distribution.

liquid.mobility_gain.note: Original sintering prefactor exp(gain*disordered volume/dry condensed volume). Zero removes this prefactor only; the separate ordered-structure activation barrier remains.

thermal.pore_radiation_factor.note: Effective wall-exchange/geometry factor in the local diffusion approximation. Zero removes only internal pore radiation, preserving exterior furnace radiation. Optical length is an evolving pore diameter, not a mesh-cell width.

transport.liquid_water_mobility.note: Reference-temperature mobility D_ref in D(T)=D_ref*exp[-E/R*(1/T-1/Tr)]. L=2*A/[R*(dx_left/(D_left*c_left)+dx_right/(D_right*c_right))] multiplies the shared entropy force including mechanical, mixing and binding terms. Zero reference mobility removes redistribution; exterior liquid flow is zero. Not a measured hydraulic or drying diffusivity.

water.retention_scale.note: Water-equivalent mass scale per initial dry mass defining initial matrix equivalents N0 for mixing and saturated binding. Current N follows the separately declared kaolin-carried site hypothesis. Not added matter, a measured site count or maximum sorption capacity. Zero N0 removes all retention.

kinetics.condensation.factor.note: Reverse phase-exchange factor multiplying the evaporation Arrhenius coefficient and existing liquid inventory for positive vapor-minus-liquid affinity. One gives symmetric bounded driving and paired flux ratio exp(-affinity); zero disables condensation and recovers the previous one-way law. Fixed at one in this conditional UQ; not a measured accommodation coefficient.

liquid.relaxation_time_ref.note: Log-odds relaxation time at the existing effective transition temperature. Zero selects the previous algebraic equilibrium model; positive values define kinetic mode. Not an experimentally measured crystallization time. With active carrier, zero time is allowed only when liquid.axial_transition_strain=0; the stress-coupled algebraic limit is not implemented. Nonzero solid.phase_modulus_contrast also requires positive relaxation time with active carrier.

liquid.relaxation_activation_energy.note: Assumed Arrhenius barrier for log-odds relaxation; cooling reduces rate and may retain disordered proxy material. Not fitted to measured viscosity or glass transition.

water.binding_energy.note: Positive binding-energy magnitude at the existing thermodynamic reference temperature. The free-energy term is -E*g at that temperature; not a measured adsorption enthalpy.

water.binding_heat_capacity.note: Positive excess heat capacity per effective bound equivalent. Constant over the virtual schedule; no experimental high-temperature adsorption law. With zero binding energy and zero capacity, recover preceding ideal-mixing retention.

process.binding_drying_extension.note: Predeclared additional virtual dry hold for one bounded response to binding-induced endpoint failure. Original nominal schedule and 0.1% criterion unchanged; all subsequent stage endpoints shift by the same duration. Not a recommendation for unmeasured real bricks.

gas.program_scale.note: Blend fraction from initial fixed inlet to declared stage endpoint compositions. Zero exactly restores the preceding constant reservoir. Applies to finite stored-gas host only.

window_thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
